name: ptoclaw
description: Plan PTO from a local SQLite database with a safe CLI and calendar sync previews.

interface.longDescription: A focused OpenClaw plugin layer for PTO Planner. PTOClaw stores settings and planned time off in local SQLite, prints readable CLI output by default, supports JSON automation, and exposes dry-run calendar sync proposals with stable external IDs.
defaultPrompt: Add a planned vacation to PTOClaw.
Preview calendar events for my PTO plan.
